exposure: Maternal obesity (BMI categories: non-obese, class I/II obese, morbidly obese, super obese)
cohort: Women who delivered via VBAC or cesarean section in the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Unit (MFMU) Cesarean Registry
finding: Super obese women (BMI ≥ 50 kg/m2) who delivered by cesarean section or VBAC had a higher risk of peripartum ICU admission compared to non-obese women.
